name: Songyue Guo
role: Ph.D. Student · Data Science and Analytics
headline:
Learning from data.
Reasoning with evidence.
bio: I am a Ph.D. student at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), supervised by Prof. Lei Chen. My research explores data-centric AI, language-model systems, and evidence-grounded reasoning.
background: Previously, I studied Computer Science and Technology at Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen), advised by Prof. Qing Liao, and received my bachelor's degree from Shandong University, advised by Prof. Yilong Yin.

topics.title: Data-centric AI
topics.text: Data quality, fair data markets, and learning from heterogeneous data.

topics.title: Language-model systems
topics.text: Efficient optimization of language-model workflows for data-intensive tasks.

topics.title: Evidence-grounded reasoning
topics.text: Retrieval and evidence selection for reliable question answering.

news.text: Less Evidence, Better Answering has been accepted to NeurIPS 2026.
FQora appeared in the Companion Proceedings of The Web Conference 2025.

publications.title: Less Evidence, Better Answering: Gain-Aware Minimal Evidence Subset Selection for Medical QA
publications.authors: Songyue Guo, Zhao Chen, Caleb Chen Cao, Lei Chen
publications.summary: A compact evidence set selected for joint utility, guided by a frozen LLM’s hidden-state features.

figure.alt: Pipeline: hybrid retrieval, frozen LLM hidden-state feature analysis, information-gain scoring, and FPTAS evidence subset selection before answer generation.
figure.label: Explore the pipeline

highlights.label: Measure information gain
highlights.text: Compare query-only and query–evidence representations across the LLM’s middle layers.

highlights.label: Select complementary evidence
highlights.text: A budget-aware FPTAS selector builds the subset, beyond an individually ranked top k.

publications.title: FQora: Towards Fair and Quality-based Online Data Marketplace
publications.authors: Songyue Guo, Maocheng Li, Zhao Chen, Caleb Chen Cao, Lei Chen
publications.summary: A quality-aware data marketplace designed to balance seller and buyer utilities.

highlights.label: Price quality-aware queries
highlights.text: An arbiter matches data to the buyer’s query and prices it using the seller’s price anchors.

highlights.label: Balance both sides
highlights.text: BPO adjusts pricing to balance the utilities of sellers and buyers.

figure.alt: FQora framework: sellers provide data and price anchors; buyers submit quality-aware queries and valuations; an arbiter prices queries and uses BPO to balance market utilities.
figure.label: Explore the market
